Subject: Indoor Seed Swap to Market on May 4

Dear valued community,

We're excited to announce the indoor seed swap event, now moving to the market on May 4 due to the rain. This change brings one packet closer to your hands. Don't miss out on this opportunity to connect with like-minded individuals and grow your garden.

Stay tuned for more updates and join us in the market on May 4 to pick up your packet. Don't forget to bring one packet for your gardening adventure.

Happy gardening!

[Founder's Name]
